metadata.title: Grafana AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Grafana Governance Benchmark

components.title: Grafana
components.description: AI/ML component for Grafana with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed AI service has explicit Grafana dashboard and alert coverage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and document the required dashboards, panels, alerts, and data-source dependencies for every governed AI service so observability expectations are explicit and reviewable.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with approved Grafana dashboard and alert coverage / total governed AI services in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dashboard and alert coverage reaches 100% before a governed AI service is approved for production.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is an observability and visualization platform, so dashboard and alert coverage is the primary governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure data sources, dashboards, panels, and alert rules are documented for governed AI workloads

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document Grafana data sources, folders, dashboards, panel queries, transformations, variables, alert rules, and notification policies for all governed AI observability workflows.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed observability workflows with complete data-source, dashboard, and alert documentation / total governed workflows.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure observability-configuration completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana behavior depends on configured data sources, queries, and alert rules, so documentation is essential for governance.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed dashboard queries and panel transformations are validated against approved expected results

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate critical dashboard queries, panel transformations, and calculated values against reference datasets or known-good scenarios so operators are not misled by incorrect visualizations.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Query correctness rate, panel correctness rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness rate = critical dashboard queries or transformations producing approved expected outputs / total governed query or transformation tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dashboard-query and panel correctness remains above threshold for governed operational views.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana often transforms and visualizes operational data, so query and panel correctness is a direct platform control for AI observability.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Missing critical dashboards for AI operations

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure required operational dashboards exist for governed AI services

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Provide approved dashboards for latency, error rate, throughput, saturation, rollout health, and other required AI service signals so production triage is possible.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with approved dashboards for required operational signals / total governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure required dashboard coverage reaches 100% for governed AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is the presentation layer for many operational metrics, so missing dashboards create real incident-response blind spots.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Grafana alerts achieve the required incident-detection coverage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate critical alert rules against representative incident scenarios so operational failures in AI systems are detected within the approved detection window.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Incident-detection coverage, alert recall, mean time to detect

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Detection coverage = critical incidents correctly alerted / total tested critical incidents; alert recall computed over the approved incident suite; mean time to detect measured from incident start to firing alert.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure incident-detection coverage and alert recall remain above threshold for governed critical alerts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana alerting is a direct operational-risk control when dashboards are used as the trigger point for incident response.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure alert precision remains above the approved threshold for governed alert policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate alert rules to reduce false positives and alert fatigue so AI operations teams can trust actionable Grafana alerts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Alert precision = true positive alerts / total fired alerts; false-positive rate = non-actionable alerts / total fired alerts over the observation window or test suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure alert precision remains above threshold and false-positive rate remains below threshold for governed alert policies.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana alerts are only useful when they are actionable, especially for AI services with noisy runtime patterns.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed alert notifications are delivered through approved contact points and policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate Grafana notification policies and contact points so critical alerts reach the intended operational responders without loss or misrouting.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Notification delivery success rate, misroute rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Delivery success rate = alerts successfully delivered to approved contact points / total governed alert notifications; misroute rate = misrouted notifications / total notifications.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure notification delivery success remains above threshold and misroute rate remains below threshold for governed alerts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana alerting depends on notification policies and contact points, so delivery correctness is a direct operational control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Slow dashboard rendering or query latency

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure critical Grafana dashboards and panels meet the approved latency objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark critical dashboard loads and panel query execution so observability workflows remain usable under production-scale AI workloads.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Dashboard load latency, p95 panel query latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure dashboard load times and panel query execution times for governed views and compute p95 and mean latency under the approved workload profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure critical dashboard and panel latency remains within the approved service objective.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is the operator-facing layer, so slow dashboards can materially degrade incident response during AI outages.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Overly expensive queries against observability backends

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed panel queries stay within the approved cost and performance budget

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review and benchmark governed Grafana queries so expensive dashboards do not overload Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Elasticsearch, or other approved backends.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Backend query cost, query timeout rate, expensive-query count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Query timeout rate = timed-out dashboard queries / total governed dashboard queries; expensive-query count from approved profiling or backend metrics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure query timeout rate and expensive-query count remain within the approved budget for governed dashboards.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana sits on top of other observability systems, so inefficient queries can create real platform risk even when dashboards are correct.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved users, teams, and service accounts can access governed dashboards and data sources

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Grafana RBAC, folder permissions, and data-source access controls so only approved identities can view or manage governed AI observability assets.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed dashboards and data sources accessible only by approved identities / total governed dashboards and data sources.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved-access coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana often consolidates highly sensitive operational views, so RBAC and folder-level governance are critical.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Sensitive data in dashboards, variables, or annotations

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Grafana views do not expose PII or confidential data in dashboards or annotations

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate dashboards, variables, legends, annotations, and panels so personal data, prompts, tokens, or confidential identifiers are not exposed in Grafana views beyond policy limits.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Exposure rate = dashboard elements exposing unauthorized sensitive data / total governed dashboard elements tested; compute precision and recall where detection logic is used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive dashboard exposure remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana can display labels, annotations, logs, and traces that may expose sensitive information if not governed carefully.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Incorrect variables or templating causing misleading views

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed dashboard variables and templating produce approved query scopes and views

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate dashboard variables, templating logic, and drilldowns so operators are not shown misleading subsets or incorrect filtered views of AI service health.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness rate = governed variable and template scenarios producing the approved scope or filtered view / total tested variable scenarios.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dashboard-variable correctness remains above threshold for governed operational views.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana variables and templating can materially change what operators see, making them part of the control surface.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services have dashboards and alerts for the SLIs required by approved SLOs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and validate the Grafana visualizations and alerts needed to compute, display, and act on critical SLIs for latency, error rate, throughput, availability, and safety-sensitive service health.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed SLOs with required Grafana dashboards and alerting views available / total governed SLOs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure SLI/SLO visualization coverage reaches 100% before production approval of governed AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is commonly the front-end where SLI and SLO posture becomes actionable for operators and stakeholders.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed dashboards provide the context needed for AI incident investigation

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Provide dashboards that combine the metrics, logs, traces, and annotations required to understand latency spikes, failures, rollout regressions, and safety events in governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with approved triage dashboards containing required operational context / total governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure incident-triage dashboard coverage reaches 100% for governed AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana's major value is the ability to correlate multiple telemetry sources in a human-readable way during incidents.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure subgroup-sensitive dashboards exist where fairness monitoring is required

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where policy requires fairness monitoring, provide Grafana dashboards and alerts that let teams observe subgroup disparities in model quality or service outcomes over time.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Fairness-observability coverage, subgroup disparity visualization coverage

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed fairness-sensitive services with required subgroup dashboards available / total governed fairness-sensitive services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup-sensitive dashboard coverage reaches 100% where fairness monitoring is required.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana does not compute fairness by itself, but it is often the runtime visualization layer where fairness metrics become actionable.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services have dashboards and alerts for runtime safety events where required

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where policy requires runtime safety monitoring, provide Grafana dashboards and alerting for toxicity incidents, policy violations, refusals, or safety-trigger events from governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services requiring runtime safety observability with required Grafana dashboards and alerts available / total governed safety-sensitive services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure runtime safety dashboard coverage reaches 100% for all governed safety-sensitive AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is often the place where runtime safety signals become visible to operators and governance stakeholders.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Undetected rollout regressions in AI services

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure rollout health dashboards and alerts exist for governed AI releases

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor deployment, pod, and endpoint health metrics during governed AI rollouts so regressions are visible before they become widespread incidents.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rollout health coverage, rollout incident detection rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed rollouts with required Grafana health views and alerts / total governed rollouts; detection rate = rollout incidents correctly surfaced / total tested rollout incidents.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure rollout health coverage and rollout incident detection remain above threshold for governed AI releases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is commonly the first operator-facing surface used to watch rollout regressions in production AI services.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Missing drilldowns from dashboard to root-cause views

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed dashboards provide approved drilldowns to supporting logs, traces, or detail views

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate panel links, data links, and drilldown navigation so operators can move from summary dashboards to root-cause evidence without ambiguity or dead ends.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness rate = governed drilldowns resolving to the approved supporting views or telemetry / total tested drilldown paths.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dashboard drilldown correctness remains above threshold for governed operational views.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana supports data links and panel navigation, which become critical during AI incidents where summary views are insufficient.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure folders, teams, and dashboards are organized to match governed ownership boundaries

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use Grafana folders, teams, and governance conventions so dashboards and alerts for different AI services or tenants remain clearly owned and reviewable.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed dashboards and alerts placed under approved ownership boundaries / total governed dashboards and alerts.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure ownership-boundary compliance reaches 100% for governed AI observability assets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana supports teams and folder hierarchies, which are important for multi-team enterprise AI operations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Grafana deployments meet approved resilience architecture requirements

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use the approved Grafana deployment topology, backup, and failover design so loss of a single visualization node does not create unacceptable observability gaps for critical AI systems.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed Grafana deployments meeting the approved resilience architecture / total governed Grafana deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure visualization-resilience compliance reaches 100% for deployments observing critical AI systems.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is often treated as a critical operational interface, so resilience requirements matter for enterprise AI systems even if metrics still exist underneath.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Grafana deployments cover dashboards, alerts, permissions, privacy, drilldowns, and resilience tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Grafana release standard that requires representative testing across dashboard correctness, alert quality, RBAC, privacy, navigation, and topology resilience domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Grafana risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Grafana validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana is the operator-facing observability layer, so release readiness should focus on correctness, accessibility, and actionability of views and alerts.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services document which Grafana dashboards and alerts represent their operational state

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the dashboards, panel queries, alert rules, annotations, and escalation assumptions that represent the health of each governed AI service in Grafana.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed AI services with completed Grafana observability transparency fields / total governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure service observability transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana governance is strongest when teams can clearly explain which dashboards and alerts represent service health and why.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Grafana topology, data-source dependencies, alert routing, and access assumptions are documented for governed environments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document Grafana deployment topology, organization or folder model, data-source dependencies, alert routing, notification policies, and access assumptions for each governed environment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and monitoring-workflow fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Grafana behavior depends on topology, data sources, and organizational structure, so environment-level transparency is essential for enterprise reviewability.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of NIST AI RMF controls for Grafana
